# Rachel Lynde

## Overview

- **Age:** Over fifty during Volume 1; in her sixties by Volume 5  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044), [v2 c25 P28](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0028), [v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** Widowed  <sub>[v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015)</sub>
- **Role:** Housewife and community leader  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Mrs. Rachel  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>; Mrs. Rachel Lynde  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Rachel Lynde is a stout woman who waddles when she walks, weighing around two hundred pounds in her later years. She possesses a very sharp, observant eye for everything that passes in her neighborhood.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031), [v1 c29 P30](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0030)_

## Personality

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is a capable, notable housewife who prides herself on always speaking her mind without fear or favor. Highly outspoken, officious, and prone to gossiping, she manages her own concerns and those of her neighbors with equal vigor. Despite her brusque, opinionated manner and sharp tongue, she possesses a warm, kind heart and is always ready to help those in need or distress. She is a devout, staunch Conservative and Presbyterian who holds very firm, traditional views on social propriety and child-rearing.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P24](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0024), [v1 c10 P33](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0033), [v1 c18 P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 c21 P5](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0005), [v1 c31 P7](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0007)_

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde lived for decades in Lynde's Hollow on the Avonlea main road with her meek husband, Thomas. Active in all local affairs, she managed her household while running the Sewing Circle, helping with the Sunday School, and leading the Church Aid Society and Foreign Missions Auxiliary. When Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert adopted Anne Shirley, Rachel expressed loud disapproval and initially clashed with Anne over her blunt criticism of the girl's looks, though she quickly accepted Anne's apology and became one of her firmest supporters. Over the years, she offered endless advice on Anne's upbringing and community matters, regularly participating in church fundraisers and political rallies. Following a prolonged illness, Thomas Lynde passed away, leaving the farm mortgaged. Facing the necessity of selling her homestead, Rachel was invited by Marilla Cuthbert to move into Green Gables. She set up her own quarters in the former spare room and helped Marilla manage the household and the Keith twins, allowing Anne to leave for college at Redmond.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P25](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0025), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c10 P30](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0030), [v1 c10 P38](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0038), [v1 c18 P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v2 c14 P5](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0005), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P21](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0021), [v2 c26 P27](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0027)_
